paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh na it un adan thusehte, adante, avaihawmte leh athupiakte na zui gige ding uh ahi.
heading: Pathian Thupina

paite: Tu in thei un, TOUPA na Pathian sawina, athupidan, aban hatdan, aban zakdan,
achiamtehnate, athilhih, Aigupta gamsung a Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh tung leh agamsung pumpi a ahihte;
Aigupta sepaihte leh asakol leh akangtalai tung a athilhihte; nou ahon delhzui ua, Tuipi San a atumsakdan, tutan a TOUPA'N ahihmanthatdante;
hiai mun na tun masiah ua gamdai a na tung ua athilhihtheihdante;

Reuben tapa Eliab tapa Dathan leh Abiram tung a ahihdan; lei in akam akat a, Israel mite tengteng lak a amaute leh a-inkuanpihte uh leh apuaninte uh leh aganhon tengteng uh avalh vekdante thei lou na suante uh kiang a thu gen ka hi kei hi.
Na mit ngei ua TOUPA'N thil thupitak, ahih tengteng mute kiang a thugen ka hi zaw hi.
Huaiziak in na hong hat ua, luah dia na va zot gam uh na luahtheihna ding un, tuni a ka hon piak thupiak tengteng na zuih ding uh ahi.
heading: Gam Chiam Vualzawlnate

paite: Nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam, na pi-le-pute leh asuante kiang a piak dia TOUPA'N akichiamna gam a na ten sawttheihna ding un.
Huai na va luah ding uh gam, na hong pawtna uh Aigupta gam, anteh-louhing huan a haichi na tuh ua, na khe ua tui na buah uh bang uh ahi kei hi.
Na va luah ding uh gam zaw, mualte leh phaizangte leh van vuahtui mu gam ahi zaw hi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh zonkhiak gam ahi a; TOUPA na Pathian uh mit kum thak a pan kum tawp pha atuk gigena gam ahi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding leh na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua a-nna sem dia tu a ka hon piak thupiak tengteng phatuamngaitak a na zuih uleh,
na gam vuahtui uh ahun geihgeih in, vuahtui ke masa leh vuahtui ke nanung ka hon pe dia, huchi in na buh uh, na uain uh, na thau uh na seklut thei ding uhi.
Na gante uh a ding in leng na loute uah loupa ka hon sawl dia, nou leng na ne ding ua, na tai ding uhi.
Pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw na lungtang uh khem in a-om dia, na pial ding ua, pathian dangte nna sem in, na be kha ding uh.
Na huchih uleh TOUPA na tung uah athangpai dia, van akhak dia, vuah azu kei dia, lei in agah apiangsak kei ding. Huchi in TOUPA'N ahon piak, gam hoih a pan na mangthang pah ding uhi.
Huaiziak in hiai ka thute na lungtang uleh na lungsim uah khum unla, chiamtehna ding in na ban uah na vial ding ua, na mit kikal uah talgakna ding in leng a-om ding ahi.
Huaite na tate uh na sinsak ding ua, na inn ua na tut lai un, lampi a na pai lai un, na lup lai un, na thoh chiang un na gen ding uhi.
Na inn kongkhak biangte uah, na kongkhakte uah na gelh ding uh ahi.
Huchi in na pi-le-pute uh piak dia akichiamna gam ah na damsung nite uh leh na tate uh damsung nite leitung a vante nite bang in asausak ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding leh alampi tengteng zui ding leh amah len tinten ding a phatuamngaitak a hiai thupiak nou ka hon piak tengteng na zuih peuhmah uleh;
TOUPA'N hiai nam tengteng ahon delhkhiaksak dia, nou sang a thupizaw leh thilhihtheizaw namte gam na luah ding uhi.
Na khepek ua na sikna peuh uh nou a ahi dia, gamdai a pan leh Lebanon tang a pan lui, Euphrates Luipi a pan tumlam tuipi pha in na gam uh ahi ding hi.
Kuamah in hon pha kei dia; TOUPA na Pathian un na kiang ua agensa bang in na va sik ding uh gam tengteng ah noute kihtakna leh lauhna a-omsak ding.
Ngai un, tuni in na ma uah vualzawlna leh hamsia ka koih hi:
TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte, tua ka hon piakte na zuih uleh, vualzawlna ahi ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte na zuih kei uleh, na theih ngei louh uh pathian dangte be ding a tua ka hon thupiakte na pialsan uleh bel, hamsiat na hi ding uh.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, na va luah ding uh gam a TOUPA na Pathian un hon pilut chiang in, Gerizim tang ah vualzawlna, Ebal tang ah hamsiatna na koih ding uhi.
Nitumna khen, Arabah a om, Kanaante gam, Gilgal zawn Moreh tosaw sik, Jordan gal ate ahi kei uh maw?
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak gam va luah ding in Jordan na kan ding ua, na luah ding ua, huai ah na teng ding uhi.
Tua na ma ua ka koih, dan leh vaihawm tengteng zui ding in na pilvang ding uh ahi.
